articles.title: 54% OF TEAMS HAD AN AI AGENT MAKE A MISTAKE LAST QUARTER. APPROVAL GATES DIDN'T LOWER IT.
articles.summary:
Leadership wants agents doing more on their own, but nearly half of teams can't fully trace what agents did. The State of Agentic AI: H2 2026 surveyed 1,030 people who build, buy, or influence AI systems:

* THE PRESSURE IS RISING: 25.3% adopt agents to meet leadership expectations, nearly double December's 13.5%. Teams letting agents act without approval rose from 4.2% to 7.5%. * APPROVALS AREN'T THE FIX: Teams that approve every action reported mistakes at 58%, vs. 52% with no approval. * VISIBILITY IS THE GAP: Only 53% can fully trace which agent did what last week.
